items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: That kind of junk was for old hustlers, you know. Yeah, like John New Orleans.

ctx.x: Had they worn those old box backs all over the country?
All over the country, but you understand the professional people didn't wear that kind of junk. That kind of junk was for old hustlers, you know. Yeah, like John New Orleans.
